name: gradient-slider
title: Gradient Slider
description: A colour slider on a hue or white-balance gradient with a ring knob, a live swatch and an action button.

perf.budget: The gradient is a static background; the knob moves on the UI thread and its colour updates once per step.

a11y.reducedMotion: The knob follows the finger without growing and the swatch changes without popping.
a11y.screenReader: Adjustable role with min, max, current value and formatted text. The swatch is decorative; the action button has its own name.
a11y.touchTarget: The track is 44 pt tall; the swatch area and action button are at least 44 pt.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add gradient-slider`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
